verdict.rationale: Phaser offers documented core APIs (Scenes, GameObjects, Loader, Animations), bundled TypeScript definitions, a large npm footprint, and a live llms.txt examples index with an examples API, all of which help LLM code generation. However, its own docs warn that Phaser 2 code and tutorials found online likely won't work in Phaser 3, and the library is now at 4.x, so model-seen examples may target incompatible APIs; some community reports also criticize the documentation. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence that LLM-generated Phaser code works on the first try, evidence of API stability across major versions, and independent confirmation of documentation quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, LLM-generated code mostly works on the first try — stable, well-documented APIs with abundant public examples the models have seen
